name: com.pdxgame.myui
description: Lightweight Unity UI management framework: full-screen layout, explicit modal input blocking, cover/pause policies, panel lifecycle, fixed layers, instance pooling and push/overlay/replace navigation. Core is pure C#. Addressables is the default loader (optional assembly with Resources fallback).

samples.description: Zero-config demo: main menu / game page / settings popup. Open any empty scene and press Play — the boot runs automatically, no scene object or camera needed.
